items.title: 3 PG students at B J Medical College suspended for 'ragging juniors'
items.summary: The report said three second-year postgraduate students in the orthopaedics department were suspended for periods ranging from six months to one year after an anonymous complaint alleging ragging of first-year PG students.
items.status: Reported disciplinary action; allegations and committee finding distinguished

items.title: Beaten, forced to trim hair: Doon Medical College student alleges assault by seniors
items.summary: A first-year student at Government Doon Medical College alleged that seniors beat him with belts and slippers, forced him to trim his hair and made him sleep outside. The anti-ragging committee began an inquiry.
items.status: Reported allegation; inquiry underway at publication

items.title: 2 MBBS students at Doon Medical College suspended after panel finds them guilty of ragging juniors
items.summary: The report said the college anti-ragging committee found two MBBS students guilty in connection with the January incident and described additional disciplinary penalties involving other students.
items.status: Reported committee finding and disciplinary action

items.title: Fresh ragging complaint at Doon Medical College; MBBS student alleges pressure to shave beard
items.summary: A fresh complaint alleged that seniors pressured an MBBS student to shave his beard and get a haircut. The college anti-ragging committee took up the complaint for investigation.

items.title: 11 MBBS students suspended in Bijnor college ragging case
items.summary: The report said 11 second-year MBBS students at a government medical college in Bijnor were suspended after an inquiry following a first-year student's ragging complaint. The college was reported to have found the students guilty.
items.status: Reported finding of guilt and disciplinary action

aliases: all india institute of medical sciences mangalagiri
items.title: Ragging at Mangalagiri AIIMS: 13 students face disciplinary action
items.summary: A newspaper report said an internal inquiry at AIIMS Mangalagiri found that ragging had occurred and 13 senior students were fined and suspended from hostel facilities.
items.status: Reported institutional finding and disciplinary action

aliases: mgm medical college and hospital jamshedpur
items.title: MGM Medical College Jamshedpur files police complaint against 5 MBBS interns over alleged ragging
items.summary: The report said MGM Medical College and Hospital filed a police complaint against five MBBS interns after juniors alleged ragging and intimidation in the hostel. The report described the allegations and the subsequent institutional and police response.
items.status: Reported police complaint; allegations not treated as convictions

aliases: mgm medical college and hospital jamshedpur
items.title: NMC seeks report from MGM Medical College Jamshedpur after MBBS student alleges ragging by seniors
items.summary: The report said the National Medical Commission sought a detailed report from Mahatma Gandhi Memorial Medical College and Hospital after a first-year MBBS student alleged ragging by seniors.
items.status: Reported regulatory inquiry; allegation under investigation

items.collegeKey: shri ram murti smarak institute of medical sciences
items.title: MD medicine medico attempts suicide over alleged ragging, 4 doctors booked
items.summary: A report said four senior resident doctors at SRMS Medical College in Bareilly were booked after a first-year MD Medicine student allegedly attempted suicide following alleged ragging and prolonged mental harassment.
items.status: Reported police case; allegations not treated as convictions
